name: See3CAM_20CUG

sources.title: 2.0 MP OV2311 USB3 Global Shutter Monochrome Camera - See3CAM_20CUG (e-con Systems product page)
sources.covers: sensor, shutter, chroma, optical format, pixel size, active area, FOV with e-con's lens, focus, output formats, frame rates, interface, power, size, mass

note: The entry is the board camera with e-con's M12 lens and no enclosure; with enclosure it is 35.30 x 35.30 x 29 mm and 65.5 g with lens. The FOV 57.6 (H) x 48.13 (V) x 70.6 (D) degrees is stated "with the lens provided by e-con", taken here to refer to the full 1600 x 1300 array (the page does not say for which resolution). The lens model is pinhole, a labelled assumption (no projection or distortion is stated; calibrate a unit); the three stated angles agree with one distortion-free pinhole with square pixels over 1600 x 1300 to 0.1 degree, which supports reading them as full-array figures. The page states "Streams HD @ 90 fps, 2MP @ 60 fps & QVGA @ 280fps" without the HD and QVGA pixel sizes or crops, so only the full-array 60 fps mode is entered as a stream; the datasheet (not read: it is a download behind e-con's document page) has the full table. Y8 is 8 bits per pixel and Y16 carries raw 10-bit data (page). Not stated: f-number, focal length. power_w is the stated maximum (0.690 W; minimum 0.430 W). size_mm is the stated l x b x h without lens, 30 x 30 x 26.9 mm, entered as [26.9, 30, 30] on the reading that h is along the optical axis (an assumption). The sensor is NIR-sensitive (page), so an IR projector of a nearby depth camera can show in its images.
